hooks.command: bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/scrape_self.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git diff --quiet -- self/inventory.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'self/inventory.md changed since last generation; consider /evolve.'; [ -s memory/failures.log ] && echo "memory/failures.log has $(wc -l < memory/failures.log) unprocessed failures; consider /evolve."; exit 0
